title: ErrorInfo
description: Machine-readable error shared by the worker API, jobs, and the desktop host. Embedded in other documents, so it has no schema_version of its own.

code.description: Stable dotted snake_case code, e.g. 'media.probe_failed'. Never localized.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Must not contain media contents or transcripts.

details.description: Extra machine-readable context. Values are scalars only.

stderr_tail.description: Last lines of a tool's stderr (e.g. FFmpeg), already redacted of user paths.
